- <a id="inv-store.persists_across_restart"></a>**`store.persists_across_restart`** · safety · durability — Stock written before a restart is the stock read after it.
- <a id="inv-store.reserve.never_negative"></a>**`store.reserve.never_negative`** · safety · correctness — A reservation larger than the stock is refused and leaves the stock unchanged; stock never goes below zero.
- <a id="inv-store.reserve.no_oversell_under_concurrency"></a>**`store.reserve.no_oversell_under_concurrency`** · safety · correctness — Two processes reserving the last units at once never both succeed. Tracked by #12.
- <a id="inv-store.restock.adds_exactly"></a>**`store.restock.adds_exactly`** · safety · correctness — Restocking n units of a SKU adds exactly n to its stock, never more and never less. Proven at any one of: unit, integration.

## Exemptions and refusals

Each ☑️ and ⛔, with the reason and the test that proves it.

- `store.memory` × `store.persists_across_restart`: exempt. Memory is the point: a restart starts empty. Nothing that needs durability uses this store. Proven by `TestIntegration_MemoryStoreForgetsOnRestart`.
- `store.file` × `sku.units/weight_kg`: unsupported. the file format stores whole numbers, so fractional kilograms cannot be kept Proven by `TestFileStore_RejectsFractionalUnits`.
